Scale and detail

Species-defining features need to remain clear. Stripes, mane, trunk, ears or horns matter more than small background variations.

Color and style

Fur easily creates confetti in photo conversion. Group shades into masses that describe volume and reserve isolated stitches for eyes, whiskers or highlights that genuinely add expression.

Limit colors deliberately. Every extra shade should add volume, separation or identity; if it appears in only a few stitches without changing the image, it may add work rather than quality. Composition and personalization
